data.name: Rift Weapon
data.description: Your understanding of the powers that move through the Outer Rifts allows you to imbue weapons with the ability to penetrate the defenses of creatures native to other planes. %1 per day as a standard action, you can touch one weapon (or a group of up to 20 similar pieces of ammunition) and give it the ability to penetrate DR/cold iron for %2 minutes.|RiftWeaponTimes|RiftWeaponDuration
